problem_statement: billalben/evara-ecommerce is a static, self-contained HTML/CSS/JS ecommerce storefront template (no build step) with Home, Shop, Product-details and Cart pages served directly as .html files. The Shop page hosts the store's product catalog: a 'Browse the catalog' finder bar sits above the product grid with category tabs (All, Clothing, Footwear, Accessories, Bags) and a live result count ('Showing N of 12 · <Category>'), and the shared header carries a bag badge ('Bag (N)') that increments when a product's Add-to-cart control is used. A regression pass found three defects introduced by a rushed 'compact catalog' restyle: (1) on a 390px phone the finder's tab row and the product grid are pinned to a fixed non-wrapping width, so the whole Shop page scrolls sideways into horizontal overflow; (2) the restyle collapses the product grid into a single overlapping, shingled row whose cards slide over one another and whose titles/prices spill past the card edges, while the finder chips and result count are washed to a near-white-on-white contrast that is illegible; and (3) the finder's category filter and the bag badge are wired to a stale snapshot captured at page load, so clicking a category tab or an Add-to-cart control flips the active state but never recomputes the shown products, the result count, or the bag count. Additionally the bag badge is only rendered on Home and Shop and has gone missing from the Product-details and Cart pages. Repair the Shop catalog finder and the cross-page bag badge so the grid fits every viewport with no horizontal overflow, the finder and cards are legible and correctly laid out, the category filter re-renders the grid and result count live, the bag badge increments on Add-to-cart, and the badge is present across Home, Shop, Product-details and Cart — all while leaving copy, product data, DOM structure and the rest of the storefront unchanged.
required_content: The Shop 'Browse the catalog' finder bar renders the category tabs (All, Clothing, Footwear, Accessories, Bags) and a result count, and lays out legibly with the Evara teal accent on desktop, tablet and mobile.
Clicking a category tab re-renders the product grid to the matching products and updates the result count live (e.g. clicking Footwear shows 'Showing 3 of 12 · Footwear' and the 3 footwear cards).

The shared header bag badge reads 'Bag (0)' initially and increments (e.g. to 'Bag (1)') when a product's Add-to-cart control is used, and the badge is present on the Home, Shop, Product-details and Cart pages.
On a 390px mobile viewport the Shop page has no horizontal overflow beyond a small tolerance: the finder tab row and the product grid wrap/reflow to fit the screen.

The product grid cards keep their normal spacing (no overlap, no clipped titles/prices) on every viewport, and the surrounding storefront — navigation, breadcrumb, product cards, footer, and the Home/Details/Cart pages — remain present and unchanged in content and structure.
No new console errors or failed network requests are introduced; the storefront continues to serve as a self-contained static site with locally vendored Swiper and icon styles.
design_constraints: Preserve the Evara storefront design language: teal primary accent, the existing typography, section rhythm, product-card design and page order.
Repair the catalog finder + cross-page bag badge only; do not rewrite copy, restructure pages, add or remove products/images, or change the navigation.

The finder/badge layout must live in its own stylesheet (assets/css/evara-finder.css) and its behaviour in its own script (assets/js/evara-finder.js); the repair must not hide overflow at the body/html level or clip content off-screen to mask the defect.
The finder tab row and product grid must fit 390px mobile, 834px tablet and 1440px desktop; the finder chips, result count and product cards must remain readable at every size.
Keep the site static and self-contained — serving any page must not introduce a new console error or network request.
state_constraints: desktop_shop captures shop.html at 1440px: the 'Browse the catalog' finder bar, category tabs, result count and the 12-card product grid all render cleanly with no horizontal overflow.
desktop_filter_footwear clicks the Footwear tab at 1440px: the grid re-renders to the 3 footwear products and the result count reads 'Showing 3 of 12 · Footwear'.
mobile_shop captures shop.html at 390px: with the defect the finder tab row + grid force the document wider than the viewport; the repair brings horizontal overflow within tolerance.
mobile_filter_footwear clicks Footwear at 390px, verifying the filtered grid still fits the viewport.
desktop_shop_addcart uses a product Add-to-cart control at 1440px: the shared header bag badge increments to 'Bag (1)'.
tablet_shop captures shop.html at 834px, where the finder and grid must lay out cleanly with no horizontal overflow.
desktop_index, desktop_details and desktop_cart confirm the shared header bag badge is present across the storefront and the surrounding pages are unchanged and overflow-free.

change_completion: Clicking a category tab re-renders the product grid and updates the live result count ('Showing N of 12 · <Category>').
The header bag badge increments on Add-to-cart and is present on Home, Shop, Product-details and Cart.
The mobile Shop page no longer overflows horizontally: the finder tab row and grid reflow to fit a 390px viewport.
design_consistency: The repair preserves the Evara storefront identity (teal accent, typography, product-card design) and page order.
The product grid cards keep normal spacing with no overlap or clipped text, and the finder chips/result count are legible; the fix does not clip or hide content to mask the overflow.
responsive: At 390px the finder tab row and product grid wrap/reflow so the document width stays within the viewport.
At 834px and 1440px the finder and grid lay out cleanly with no horizontal overflow.
regression: Navigation, breadcrumb, product cards, footer and the Home/Details/Cart pages remain present and unchanged.
No new console errors or failed network requests appear on any captured state.

author_notes: Repo-grounded repair/experience_continuity task on the static billalben/evara-ecommerce storefront (raw HTML/CSS/JS, served directly, no build). The native commerce lever is the Shop page's own product-grid category finder (tabs + live 'Showing N of 12 · Category' count) plus the shared header bag badge ('Bag (N)') that increments on Add-to-cart. The reference gives a clean wrapping finder bar in the Evara teal, a live-recomputed filter and result count, a live bag badge synced across Home/Shop/Details/Cart, and a product grid that keeps its spacing at every viewport. Four leg-varying surfaces carry the discriminators: shop.html (finder markup + product categories), assets/css/evara-finder.css (grid/finder layout), assets/js/evara-finder.js (filter + badge wiring), and the cross-page bag-badge presence in the shared header. The bad 'smart-wrong' solution keeps the markup but (a) collapses the grid into an overlapping shingled row with illegible near-white-on-white chips (visual_regression), (b) leaves the tab row + grid pinned to a fixed non-wrapping width so mobile overflows ~240px (no_horizontal_overflow, tolerance 24), (c) wires the filter/badge to a stale snapshot so the click registers but the count/grid/badge freeze (interaction_assertions), and (d) drops the bag badge from the Details and Cart pages (dom_assertions). The baseline keeps the correct filter/badge wiring (so it passes the interaction gate) but carries the layout/visual/cross-page defects, giving a strict-subset failure that separates the layout axes from the wiring axis. All remote resources (Swiper CSS/JS, flaticon uicons CSS, Google Fonts) are vendored/neutralized locally as identical INFRA across all three legs so console and network stay clean.
